The infant is feeding well and was born full-term, which supports a benign etiology. Given the negative Coombs test, normal bilirubin level, and classic presentation of jaundice appearing after the first few days in an exclusively breastfed infant, this is consistent with breast milk jaundice.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast milk jaundice
